Upstream package metadata declarations (not complete copyright notices).

Both packages omit a top-level LICENSE/COPYING file in their published archive.
Do not treat these declarations as proof that the missing author-issued text
has been recovered. In particular, the inherited Google Brotli decoder has
Apache-2.0 source notices, preserved in pdf-lib-fontkit-1.1.1-NOTICES.txt.
